results.title: Thirty windows, one button - Product Hunt
results.content:
Wokyintosh turns a spare Mac display into a Macintosh dashboard: a big clock and date, the weather, whatever is playing on Apple Music or Spotify with the artwork, and a few system stats, all in black and white with the old chrome. Salar Farahani bought a retro dock station for his Mac mini, liked the hardware, then spent months failing to find a dashboard for its little screen, including ones he was willing to pay for. He is not a macOS developer. He built it with ChatGPT next to him, learning and debugging as he went, and it is free and open source, and he is already in the comments talking about cutting redraws so an always-on dashboard does not sit there eating a laptop battery.
